title: Regulation of TGF-beta1, PI3K/PIP3/Akt, Nrf-2/Keap-1 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways to avert bifenthrin induced hepatic injury: A palliative role of daidzein.
authors: El Safadi, Mahmoud; Shah, Tawaf Ali; Zahara, Syeda Sania; Bin Jardan, Yousef A; Bourhia, Mohammed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大豆苷元对联苯菊酯诱导大鼠肝损伤的保护作用，涉及信号通路表达与分子模拟，但核心是毒理学与药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模内容。
abstract: Bifenthrin (BFN) is a noxious insecticide which is reported to damage various body organs. Daidzein (DZN) is a natural flavone with excellent pharmacological properties. This research was conducted to evaluate the alleviative strength of DZN to counteract BFN prompted liver toxicity in male albino rats. Thirty-two rats were divided into 4 groups i.e., the control, BFN (7 mg /kg), BFN (7 mg/kg) + DZN (20 mg/kg) and DZN (20 mg/kg) alone group. The biochemical assessment was performed by using qRT PCR as well as standard ELISA protocols. The findings are validated by applying pharmacodynamic techniques including molecular simulation. It was observed that BFN reduced the gene expressions of phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K), phosphatidylinositol-3, 4, 5-triphosphate (PIP3), Protein kinase B (Akt), nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf-2) while promoting the gene expressions of Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap-1). Moreover, BFN notably reduced the activities of glutathione reductase (GSR), heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and catalase (CAT) while elevating the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA). BFN promoted the levels of matrix metallopeptidase 2 (MMP-2), Procollagen III N-terminal Pro-peptide (PIIINP), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), transforming growth factor-beta-1 (TGF-beta1), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), tissue inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases 1 (TIMP1), and alanine aminotransferase (ALT). The levels of nuclear factor- kappa B (NF-kappaB), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1beta), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-6 (IL-6) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) were increased following the BFN intoxication. BFN enhanced the expressions of cysteine-aspartic acid protease-3 (Caspase-3) and Bcl-2-associated X protein (Bax) while suppressing the gene expression of B-cell lymphoma-2 (Bcl-2). Moreover, BFN disrupted the normal histology of liver tissues. Nonetheless, DZN treatment remarkably alleviated hepatic damages owing to its antioxidative, anti-apoptotic as well as anti-inflammatory abilities. However, DZN supplementation remarkably safeguarded which is further confirmed by in-silico assessment.
abstract_zh: 联苯菊酯（Bifenthrin, BFN）是一种有害杀虫剂，据报道可损害多种身体器官。大豆苷元（Daidzein, DZN）是一种具有优良药理特性的天然黄酮类化合物。本研究旨在评估DZN对雄性白化大鼠中BFN诱导的肝脏毒性的缓解作用。将32只大鼠分为4组，即对照组、BFN（7 mg/kg）组、BFN（7 mg/kg）+DZN（20 mg/kg）组和DZN（20 mg/kg）单独组。通过使用qRT PCR以及标准ELISA方案进行生化评估。通过应用包括分子模拟在内的药效学技术验证了研究结果。观察到BFN降低了磷酸肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）、磷脂酰肌醇-3,4,5-三磷酸（PIP3）、蛋白激酶B（Akt）、核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf-2）的基因表达，同时促进了Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap-1）的基因表达。此外，BFN显著降低了谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性，同时升高了活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）的水平。BFN促进了基质金属肽酶2（MMP-2）、前胶原III型N端前肽（PIIINP）、碱性磷酸酶（ALP）、转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）、基质金属蛋白酶组织抑制剂1（TIMP1）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）的水平。BFN中毒后，核因子-κB（NF-κB）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2）的水平升高。BFN增强了半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-3（Caspase-3）和Bcl-2相关X蛋白（Bax）的表达，同时抑制了B细胞淋巴瘤-2（Bcl-2）的基因表达。此外，BFN破坏了肝脏组织的正常组织学结构。然而，DZN治疗因其抗氧化、抗凋亡以及抗炎能力显著缓解了肝脏损伤。此外，DZN补充显著保护了肝脏，这通过计算机模拟评估进一步得到确认。
